title: entity.updated
description: An existing entity was mutated. Carries the full post-change body so projections remain pure functions of the log. Immutable types (TestResult) must not emit this event; they emit a superseding event instead (constraint C-003).

entity.description: Full post-change entity body, same shape as entity.created.entity.

changedFields.description: Dotted paths of changed attributes. Enables delta propagation without diffing the body.
